title: Cambridge University
body: The Department of Architecture is part of the Faculty of Architecture and History of Art in the University of Cambridge. Both Departments are housed in Scroope Terrace on Trumpington Street and they share a library. The Faculty celebrated its Centenary in 2012. The University of Cambridge is one of the world's leading Universities and the Architecture Department is consistently rated in the top three in national surveys. The school has a strong research reputation in both history/theory and in scientific research, particularly into modeling and sustainable design.
